note: Round 18 (item 4): the drive-through drainage pipes, hand-made layout (Dan: pipes are their own layer under the terrain). Each pipe runs straight from 'a' to 'b' (map x, z in meters): a concrete inlet cut leading down from the ground at 'a', a round concrete pipe under the ground, an outlet cut leading up to the ground at 'b' (P1: on the small pond's west shore, just outside the water). Heights, the depth and where the cuts end are worked out by MapBuilder.Pipes.cs from the ground. 'forward' is a to b. 'approach_a' / 'approach_b': optional lines (x, z, ...) leading to a mouth: graded like the trail's fords (down a bank at 22 % at most, across a stream on a gravel bar 0.15 m under the water), so the mouth is met from the ground. 'rock_bar_a' (Round 19, BUG-001): the way to the inlet crosses the creek on a dry bar of flat rocks instead of a gravel bar under the water. The map-wide network (Round 20) goes in this file.
